description: Download a lecture's caption track and save it as a text transcript on local disk. Returns the saved path. Get media_id from list_media_objects and track_id from get_media_captions.

dest_dir.description: Local folder to save into. Defaults to the server's download folder (CANVAS_DOWNLOAD_DIR).

media_id.description: Media object ID, e.g. "m-abc123". Get it from list_media_objects.

track_id.description: Defaults to the first English track

name: download_media_captions
title: Download Media Captions
